All settings in this screen go back to their defaults. Points, stickers and paired devices stay.

KiloQuest has no ads, no tracking and no analytics, and no account.

On this device only: points, stickers, settings, figures, the travel diary and photos. Nothing of this is uploaded. Backups of the app data are switched off. You can delete single photo entries, the whole diary, or export everything as a ZIP file in Settings.

Services that receive requests (your IP address and the places needed for the request, no name, no account):
• Your own routing server (routes, speed limits): your server may log requests; you are its operator.
• Photon / komoot (place search, country of a position), Overpass API (rest stops, viewpoints), OpenFreeMap (map tiles), Wikipedia (stories), Open-Meteo (weather), iNaturalist (animal quests), Autobahn API (German traffic).

Paired devices exchange game state, route, position of the car, speed and distance only via Bluetooth, and only with devices you allowed.

Camera and microphone: the camera is used only when the co-driver taps "Take photo"; the microphone only for voice answers and, if you switch it on, for commands with the name "Kilo". Speech is recognised on the device and is not stored. Photos are re-encoded without location data.

Details: docs/legal/datenschutz.md in the project.

Maps: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), map tiles from OpenFreeMap, rendering by MapLibre (BSD).
Routing: Valhalla (MIT).
Stories: Wikipedia (CC BY-SA). Animals: iNaturalist. Weather: Open-Meteo. Traffic: Autobahn GmbH.

3D figures: Kenney (kenney.nl), CC0: Car Kit, Train Kit, Watercraft Kit, Space Kit, Cube Pets, Mini Characters, Blocky Characters; aircraft from OpenGameArt, CC0.
Kilo and emoji: Noto Emoji (Google).
Icons: Material Symbols (Apache 2.0).
Fonts: Atkinson Hyperlegible and Nunito (SIL OFL 1.1).

KiloQuest always shows the speed limit. Warnings about speed cameras are switched off in every country, because the law differs and is changing: in some countries drivers may not use them at all, in others the rules are unclear or disputed. A country is only enabled after a documented legal check. This is not legal advice.
